integrity: An explicit complete ray-case proof and reproducible bounded integer checks support the theorem. The bounded calculations are not a proof of the infinite statement. Independent validation was not performed.
limitations: Only the identity component for three-layer ordinal sums with exterior sizes at least two; no claim about disconnected components, central isogenies, or other posets. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Middle-tier cardinality governs reductivity in three-level Hibi toric varieties
